==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I remember everything being covered in a thick purple and black fog. I can hear a song I remember from an old videogame. The song combines hip-hop elements and opera style vocals.

Two men with spiky black hair and brown eyes are getting ready to battle. One of the men is wearing blue armor and the other is wearing an orange martial arts gi. There is a shimmering rainbow aura around both men.

I am surprised and excited to see that these two are going to fight each other. Just as the fight is about to start, the fog begins to dissipate and I see that we're in a bamboo forest. My alarm goes off and I wake up before the fight begins.
